alignments.note: The adverb takes the whole correlative Even so, headed on so; no answering καί stands in the verse (rules 82, 100).
Expressed copula with its supplied subject pronoun.
Anarthrous noun with its supplied determiner, no article competing (rule 51).
Improper preposition rendered by the single word of; the determiner slot on the governed noun is taken by your, so the preposition stays with the adverb (rules 36, 101).
The genitive pronoun writes your, displacing the determiner (rule 20).
Second attributive article before a verbless prepositional modifier keeps the relativizer (rule 31).
The supplied copula goes with the prepositional predicate (rules 31, 53).
Subjunctive with its auxiliary, headed on the lexical verb (rule 9).

Corrected. The article governs a substantival adjective, so the supplied generic noun ones is the article's own (rules 17, 102); the demonstrative these displaces the determiner slot and nothing else (rules 38, 49), so the article is not emptied of the nominal the ASV supplies for it.

Corrected. The adjective keeps its bare word little; with no determiner standing on the article to anchor it, the partitive of stays with the adjective under rule 21's determinerless clause. Discontinuous under rule 15.
Attributive demonstrative supplies the English determiner (rule 38).

review_notes: Corrected the τῶν μικρῶν τούτων phrase as at 18:6 and 18:10, so that one construction takes one analysis across the chapter (rule 24).

The ASV gloss and variant notes (Greek a thing willed before your Father; some authorities read my) record the reading the projection carries and are translated, so nothing is added or unrepresented on their account.
